Rosa (Finance): Heads up — BridgeTech (acct BT-442) hasn't paid invoice 22451 due 03/05, ACH attempt failed this morning. putting on collections queue.
Ajay Patel: saw that, bank returned R02 (insufficient funds) on the ACH. customer had a usage spike in Feb — contesting part of the invoice.
Marta Li: FYI I emailed their finance lead at 10:12am. They asked for a short-term credit hold while they reconcile usage.
Rosa (Finance): Sharing more context: Feb usage + overage (~$48k) + they were on a trial tier last quarter. They accepted the base subscription but dispute the overage calc.
Collections Bot: Reminder: invoice 22451 is 12 days past due — next automated dunning scheduled 3/2 09:00 UTC.
Ajay Patel: recommend we pause model access after 5pm PST today unless we get a partial payment. Can we approve a temporary hold?
Marta Li: we can pause non-essential API keys only (customer-facing webhooks must stay for live demos). They asked for a 60-day installment plan: 30% now, rest over 2 months.
Rosa (Finance): Need approval for the payment plan + waive late fee if they pay 30% today. Also request to route to legal if they refuse installment.
Jordan (Legal Ops): if they accept installment we need an amended payment agreement. low risk but add 1.5% interest for installments. I'll draft.
Rosa (Finance): sample language I used previously: ```We agree to a three‑part installment for invoice 22451: 30% due within 48 hours; 35% due in 30 days; 35% due in 60 days. Late payments revert to original collections flow.```
Ajay Patel: operational note — if they do partial ACH, mark as "partial paid" in ledger and queue follow-up for reconciler. I can create the payment plan in the billing portal once legal signs off.
Marta Li: customer reply (excerpt): "We can do 30% today, but need the overage breakdown before committing to the rest." I attached the usage CSV in the thread DM.
Rosa (Finance): action items: 1) Jordan to send agreement template (today EOD). 2) Ajay to prepare billing portal plan (once agreement signed). 3) Marta to send detailed usage calc and schedule a call.
Jordan (Legal Ops): will send draft by 18:00 PST. ping me if they push back on interest.
Ajay Patel: tagging payments team: @payments-team — please stand by for the partial ACH flag and to set credit hold at 17:00 PST if no partial payment.
Collections Bot: Note recorded: escalation level -> "collections outreach: manager". Next automated email will include installment offer template.
Marta Li: I'll escalate to account director if they ask for full waiver.
Rosa (Finance): thanks — I'll update the CRM and set reminders. if anyone sees an inbound reply, drop it here and I'll hop on the call. :phone:
Ajay Patel: thanks — will update once ACH clears or hold is applied.
Marta Li: call scheduled for 3/3 14:00 PST pending their availability.
